command:
set -euo pipefail; BASE=/workspace/frankgrid10-organ; SRC=/workspace/.frankgrid10-organ-src-new; rm -rf "$SRC"; ORIGIN=$(git -C /workspace/clay-global-research-entity remote get-url origin); git clone --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-frankgrid10-sandbox "$ORIGIN" "$SRC"; mkdir -p "$BASE/state" "$BASE/logs" "$BASE/receipts" "$BASE/run"; rm -rf "$BASE/code.new"; mkdir -p "$BASE/code.new"; cp -a "$SRC/research_entity/experiments/chatgpt_frankgrid10/." "$BASE/code.new/"; cd "$BASE/code.new"; python3 materialize_v2.py; test "$(sha256sum frankgrid10_v2.py | awk '{print $1}')" = 60ec27675b2900e9f71f3c22f50cb3ca28231272d4f3bb7ec016b3127608a03e; SELFTEST=$(python3 frankgrid10_v2.py --db "$BASE/state/frankgrid10.sqlite3" selftest); printf '%s\n' "$SELFTEST" | tee "$BASE/receipts/selftest-v02.json"; printf '%s\n' "$SELFTEST" | grep -q '"selftest": "PASS"'; python3 frankgrid10_v2.py --db "$BASE/state/frankgrid10.sqlite3" status >/dev/null; python3 - "$BASE/state/frankgrid10.sqlite3" "$BASE/code.new/checkpoints/20260912T0249Z-v2.json" <<'PY'
import json, sqlite3, sys, time
db, cp_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
cp=json.load(open(cp_path,encoding='utf-8'))
c=sqlite3.connect(db)
c.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON')
for x in cp['cells']:
    c.execute('UPDATE cell_state SET state=?,wins=?,updated_at=? WHERE cell_id=?',(float(x['state']),int(x['wins']),time.time(),x['cell_id']))
c.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta(k,v) VALUES('rehydrated_checkpoint_id',?)",(cp['checkpoint_id'],))
c.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta(k,v) VALUES('rehydrated_checkpoint_state_sha256',?)",(cp['state_sha256'],))
c.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta(k,v) VALUES('rehydration_scope','CELL_STATE_AND_WINS_ONLY_NO_FAKE_TURN_HISTORY')")
c.commit()
print('RESTORED_CELLS',len(cp['cells']))
print('CHECKPOINT_ID',cp['checkpoint_id'])
print('CHECKPOINT_STATE_SHA256',cp['state_sha256'])
print('HISTORY_RECONSTRUCTED',False)
PY
python3 frankgrid10_v2.py --db "$BASE/state/frankgrid10.sqlite3" ingest --role TOOL_EVIDENCE --source-kind REENTRY_CHECKPOINT --content-file "$BASE/code.new/checkpoints/20260912T0249Z-v2.json" --confidence 1.0 --salience 0.95 --source-ref 'git:chatgpt-frankgrid10-sandbox/checkpoints/20260912T0249Z-v2.json' | tee "$BASE/receipts/checkpoint-admission.json"; python3 frankgrid10_v2.py --db "$BASE/state/frankgrid10.sqlite3" checkpoint --out "$BASE/receipts/post-deploy-checkpoint.json"; python3 frankgrid10_v2.py --db "$BASE/state/frankgrid10.sqlite3" status | tee "$BASE/receipts/post-deploy-status.json"; rm -rf "$BASE/code.prev"; if [ -d "$BASE/code" ]; then mv "$BASE/code" "$BASE/code.prev"; fi; mv "$BASE/code.new" "$BASE/code"; rm -rf "$SRC"; printf '%s\n' 'FRANKGRID10_V02_DEPLOY_PASS'
